title: Ezekiel 48
paragraphs: ¹ These are the names of the tribes: From the northern end, along the road of Hethlon to Lebo-hamath, all the way to Hazar-enon, on the northern border of Damascus, northward beside Hamath — Dan shall have one portion. Its borders shall run from east to west. ² Adjoining Dan's territory from east to west — Asher shall have one portion. ³ Adjoining Asher's territory from east to west — Naphtali shall have one portion. ⁴ Adjoining Naphtali's territory from east to west — Manasseh shall have one portion. ⁵ Adjoining Manasseh's territory from east to west — Ephraim shall have one portion.

⁶ Adjoining Ephraim's territory from east to west — Reuben shall have one portion. ⁷ Adjoining Reuben's territory from east to west — Judah shall have one portion. ⁸ Adjoining Judah's territory from east to west shall be the sacred portion you are to set apart — twenty-five thousand cubits wide, extending in length from east to west the same as one of the tribal portions. The sanctuary shall be in the center of it. ⁹ The sacred portion you set apart for the LORD shall be twenty-five thousand cubits long and ten thousand cubits wide. ¹⁰ This holy portion shall be divided as follows: the priests shall have a section twenty-five thousand cubits long on the north side, ten thousand cubits wide on the west, ten thousand cubits wide on the east, and twenty-five thousand cubits long on the south, with the LORD's sanctuary in the center.

¹¹ This sacred area shall belong to the consecrated priests — the descendants of Zadok — who were faithful to me and did not go astray as the Levites did when the Israelites went astray. ¹² It shall be a most holy portion for them, set apart from the Levites' territory. ¹³ Alongside the priests' territory, the Levites shall have a portion twenty-five thousand cubits long and ten thousand cubits wide. The total length shall be twenty-five thousand cubits and the width ten thousand. ¹⁴ They must not sell or exchange any of it, nor transfer any of this choice land, because it is holy to the LORD. ¹⁵ The remaining strip of land — five thousand cubits wide and twenty-five thousand cubits long — shall be for common use: for the city, its houses, and its open land. The city shall be in the center.

¹⁶ These shall be the city's measurements: on the north side, four thousand five hundred cubits; on the south side, four thousand five hundred cubits; on the east side, four thousand five hundred cubits; and on the west side, four thousand five hundred cubits. ¹⁷ The city shall have open land: two hundred fifty cubits on the north, two hundred fifty cubits on the south, two hundred fifty cubits on the east, and two hundred fifty cubits on the west. ¹⁸ The remaining land alongside the sacred portion shall be ten thousand cubits on the east side and ten thousand cubits on the west side. Its produce will provide food for the workers of the city. ¹⁹ The workers of the city from all the tribes of Israel shall farm it. ²⁰ The entire sacred portion shall be twenty-five thousand cubits square. Together with the city property, you shall set it apart as the sacred portion.

²¹ What remains on both sides of the sacred portion and the city property shall belong to the prince. This area lies alongside the twenty-five-thousand-cubit portion, extending east to the eastern border and west to the western border, running parallel to the tribal portions. It shall belong to the prince, with the sacred portion and the temple sanctuary in the center of it. ²² The land belonging to the Levites and the land belonging to the city shall lie within the area assigned to the prince, between the borders of Judah and Benjamin. ²³ As for the rest of the tribes: from east to west, Benjamin shall have one portion. ²⁴ Adjoining Benjamin's territory from east to west — Simeon shall have one portion. ²⁵ Adjoining Simeon's territory from east to west — Issachar shall have one portion.

²⁶ Adjoining Issachar's territory from east to west — Zebulun shall have one portion. ²⁷ Adjoining Zebulun's territory from east to west — Gad shall have one portion. ²⁸ Gad's southern border shall run from Tamar to the waters of Meribah-kadesh, then along the brook of Egypt to the Mediterranean Sea. ²⁹ This is the land you shall distribute by lot as an inheritance to the tribes of Israel, and these are their allotments, declares the Lord GOD. ³⁰ These are the exits of the city: on the north side, which measures four thousand five hundred cubits,

³¹ the gates of the city will be named after the tribes of Israel. On the north side there will be three gates: one gate for Reuben, one gate for Judah, and one gate for Levi. ³² On the east side, which is four thousand five hundred cubits long, there will be three gates: one gate for Joseph, one gate for Benjamin, and one gate for Dan. ³³ On the south side, which measures four thousand five hundred cubits, there will be three gates: one gate for Simeon, one gate for Issachar, and one gate for Zebulun. ³⁴ On the west side, which is four thousand five hundred cubits long, there will be three gates: one gate for Gad, one gate for Asher, and one gate for Naphtali. ³⁵ The total circumference of the city will be eighteen thousand cubits. And the name of the city from that day on will be: The LORD Is There.
